title: The questions that follow, and answering "why did you do it that way"

videos.script: The two minutes end, and the interviewer asks a question. Usually it is some version of why: why did you do it that way, why not this other thing everybody uses. {{why}} That question is not an attack. It is the interview. The interviewer is not checking whether your choice was right; there is rarely a single right choice. They are checking whether you made it, and whether you know what it cost. {{check}} The why question has a shape, and so does the question you cannot answer. loanbook's likely questions come with their answers. And its weaknesses are named before anybody else names them.
